content: Indication-specific dosing for JT48, also known as JTT (Juzentaihoto), has not been explicitly specified. However, it is considered potentially effective as an adjunct to chemotherapy. It may enhance the therapeutic effects of antineoplastic agents while reducing their associated adverse drug reactions (ADRs). No adverse effects have been reported in the available data. The primary contraindication is hypersensitivity to the medication or its components. Regarding pregnancy, the medication is categorized as N/A, meaning there is insufficient data to assign a specific pregnancy category. Similarly, lactation safety is also categorized as N/A, indicating a lack of sufficient information. However, in general, the medication is considered acceptable for use, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Information on the metabolism and excretion of the drug is not available. The medication is noted to have immunomodulatory properties, specifically with stimulatory effects.
